name: fcs-carsharing
description: PWA di car sharing tra colleghi

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.db:demo: npm run build:shared && npm run db:demo -w api
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run start:dev -w api
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test -w @fcs/shared && npm test -w api && npm test -w web -- --watch=false
scripts.e2e: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w api && npm test -w e2e
